name: Voice
summary: Hears you and answers out loud, with Whisper and Piper running on this machine.

requires.why: To hear you when you speak. The recording is turned into text here and the sound is not kept.
To read an answer out loud through your speakers.
To open a recording you point it at.
To keep Whisper and the speech model in a folder of its own.
To fetch Whisper and Piper once from GitHub, and a speech model and a voice once from Hugging Face.
To run Whisper and Piper here rather than sending anything away to be listened to or read out.

settings.label: Speech model
settings.hint: Bigger is more accurate and slower. Tiny is 75 MB, base 148 MB, small 488 MB.

settings.label: Processor threads
settings.hint: More is faster until it is not. Four suits most machines.

settings.label: Speaking voice
settings.hint: Amy and Lessac are 63 MB each. Ryan is 114 MB and the clearest of the three.

settings.label: Whisper program
settings.hint: Leave this empty and Alexia downloads one. Point it at your own whisper-cli if you have a build that suits this machine better.

settings.label: Piper program
settings.hint: The same again for speaking. Empty means Alexia fetches one; on a machine with no prebuilt Piper this is how you supply your own.

settings.label: Download now
settings.hint: Fetches Whisper, Piper, the speech model and the voice. It happens on first use anyway; this is for getting it over with while you are looking.
